limitations: The information cutoff is 18 Nov 2026 16:20 BRT; US and Brazilian equity closes refer to 17 Nov.
The European Commission 2026–2028 forecasts and Nvidia's next-quarter guidance are projections, while October Eurostat/ONS figures are observed outcomes.

Anthropic's $900.9 billion aggregate includes obligations and commitments with different legal forms; $186.2 billion is subject to termination rights or contingent conditions, $150–175 billion of additional non-fixed-dollar arrangements is excluded, and $4.2 billion of the $70.7 billion due within 12 months is conditional or terminable.
Market index moves do not identify capital flows or private spreads without dedicated issuance and lending data.

The FOMC minutes were public at 16:00 BRT and are incorporated as a staff and participant risk assessment, not evidence of realized AI-related losses. The Brazilian PLP 299/2026 vote remained prospective at the 16:20 cutoff.

contrary_evidence: Eurostat's final energy rate rose relative to the flash estimate while the overall 4.0% rate was unchanged.
US manufacturing output rose 0.3% despite a 0.4% fall in aggregate industrial production.
The RBA recorded a divided six-to-three decision, evidencing uncertainty about optimal restrictive policy.
UK unemployment declined in a rolling-quarter survey while provisional payroll employment weakened.
US sovereign yields eased while multiple equity indexes fell.

The FOMC staff judged the banking system well capitalized and household balance sheets a buffer against financial shocks, even while flagging AI-related debt, opaque financing structures, elevated asset valuations and hedge-fund leverage.
